title.zh: 太空城邦：冠军之铸现场秀！

label.zh: 12个月后比武开幕（至少两支参赛舰队）
label.en: 12 months later the tournament opens (two or more contestants)

bridges.evidence: nomads.250 schedules system_event nomads.260 months = 12 (L2757-2790); 260 sends nomads.270 when enough contestant fleets are present (L2950-2975)
nomads.260 schedules nomads.281 years = 3; 281 fires nomads.306 if the tournament is still ongoing (L3315-3330)
on_space_battle_over -> nomads.275 -> nomads.280 after 30 days (00_on_actions.txt:1754; L3188-3252); 280 notifies each contestant parent by fleet flag (L3252-3305)
nomads.280 L3298-3304 (fleets still flagged as contestants)

label.zh: 奥伦·维斯首次击毁“清洗过人口”之国的舰队
label.en: Orun Veyth first destroys a fleet of an empire that purged pops

bridges.evidence: on_fleet_destroyed_perp -> nomads.1510 (00_on_actions.txt:1697; L8293-8320): hired_nomadic_revenant, leader flag nomadic_revenant, victim has first_pop_purged

label.zh: 塞罗首次发现未开智生物

bridges.evidence: on_survey_planet -> nomads.1524 (00_on_actions.txt:1176; L8683-8705), or arkship deep scan / subspace image -> nomads.1523 (nomads.4000 / 4300) with the naturalist leader

label.zh: 索拉斯单元在任时首次完成合约
label.en: First contract completed with Unit Solace

bridges.evidence: any contract on_success -> nomads.3002 (1 day) -> nomads.1535 after 15 days if a leader has leader_trait_nomadic_caregiver (L11299-11304, L8920-8935)

label.zh: 萨尔首次率军攻占星球
label.en: Th'aal first wins a planetary invasion

bridges.evidence: on_colony_attackers_win -> nomads.1556 (00_on_actions.txt:843; L9185-9210) -> nomads.1560 after 2 days (random 1/4 while fewer than 7 trophies) -> 1565 the first time

label.zh: 每次招募随机出现一位英杰

note.zh: 城邦的招募选项每次随机给出六位之一（已被雇佣者不再出现）。
note.en: Each recruitment offers one of the six at random (paragons already hired are excluded).

note.zh: 每个参赛帝国按自己舰队的名次只收到其中一份。
note.en: Each participating empire receives only the one matching its fleet's placing.

scope.zh: 已对照游戏文件核对入口与触发、条件、选项与结果、分类，并撰写双语导读。
scope.en: Root and trigger, conditions, options and outcomes, and category checked against the game files; bilingual guide written.
